versos.grego: Καὶ ἐμβὰς εἰς πλοῖον διεπέρασεν, καὶ ἦλθεν εἰς τὴν ἰδίαν πόλιν.

controles.web: He entered into a boat, and crossed over, and came into his own city.
controles.kjv: And he entered into a ship, and passed over, and came into his own city.
controles.livre: Então ele entrou no barco, passou para a outra margem, e veio à sua própria cidade.

versos.grego: Καὶ ἰδοὺ προσέφερον αὐτῷ παραλυτικὸν ἐπὶ κλίνης βεβλημένον. καὶ ἰδὼν ὁ Ἰησοῦς τὴν πίστιν αὐτῶν εἶπεν τῷ παραλυτικῷ Θάρσει, τέκνον, ἀφίενταί σου αἱ ἁμαρτίαι.

controles.web: Behold, they brought to him a man who was paralyzed, lying on a bed. Jesus, seeing their faith, said to the paralytic, “Son, cheer up! Your sins are forgiven you.”
controles.kjv: And, behold, they brought to him a man sick of the palsy, lying on a bed: and Jesus seeing their faith said unto the sick of the palsy; Son, be of good cheer; thy sins be forgiven thee.
controles.livre: E eis que lhe trouxeram um paralítico, deitado em um leito. Quando Jesus viu a fé deles, disse ao paralítico: Tem bom ânimo, filho! Teus pecados são perdoados.

versos.grego: καὶ ἰδού τινες τῶν γραμματέων εἶπαν ἐν ἑαυτοῖς Οὗτος βλασφημεῖ.

controles.web: Behold, some of the scribes said to themselves, “This man blasphemes.”
controles.kjv: And, behold, certain of the scribes said within themselves, This man blasphemeth.
controles.livre: E eis que alguns dos escribas disseram entre si: Ele blasfema.

versos.grego: καὶ εἰδὼς ὁ Ἰησοῦς τὰς ἐνθυμήσεις αὐτῶν εἶπεν Ἵνα τί ἐνθυμεῖσθε πονηρὰ ἐν ταῖς καρδίαις ὑμῶν;

controles.web: Jesus, knowing their thoughts, said, “Why do you think evil in your hearts?
controles.kjv: And Jesus knowing their thoughts said, Wherefore think ye evil in your hearts?
controles.livre: Mas Jesus, vendo seus pensamentos, disse: Por que pensais o mal em vossos corações?

versos.grego: τί γάρ ἐστιν εὐκοπώτερον, εἰπεῖν Ἀφίενταί σου αἱ ἁμαρτίαι, ἢ εἰπεῖν Ἔγειρε καὶ περιπάτει;

controles.web: For which is easier, to say, ‘Your sins are forgiven;’ or to say, ‘Get up, and walk?’
controles.kjv: For whether is easier, to say, Thy sins be forgiven thee; or to say, Arise, and walk?
controles.livre: Pois o que é mais fácil? Dizer: “Teus pecados foram perdoados”, ou dizer: “Levanta-te, e anda”?

versos.grego: ἵνα δὲ εἰδῆτε ὅτι ἐξουσίαν ἔχει ὁ Υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς ἀφιέναι ἁμαρτίας— τότε λέγει τῷ παραλυτικῷ Ἔγειρε ἆρόν σου τὴν κλίνην καὶ ὕπαγε εἰς τὸν οἶκόν σου.

controles.web: But that you may know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins...” (then he said to the paralytic), “Get up, and take up your mat, and go up to your house.”
controles.kjv: But that ye may know that the Son of man hath power on earth to forgive sins, (then saith he to the sick of the palsy,) Arise, take up thy bed, and go unto thine house.
controles.livre: Ora, para que saibais que o Filho do homem tem autoridade na terra para perdoar pecados,(Ele, então, disse ao paralítico): Levanta-te, toma o teu leito, e vai para tua casa.

versos.grego: καὶ ἐγερθεὶς ἀπῆλθεν εἰς τὸν οἶκον αὐτοῦ.

controles.web: He arose and departed to his house.
controles.kjv: And he arose, and departed to his house.
controles.livre: E este se levantou e foi para sua casa.

versos.grego: ἰδόντες δὲ οἱ ὄχλοι ἐφοβήθησαν καὶ ἐδόξασαν τὸν Θεὸν τὸν δόντα ἐξουσίαν τοιαύτην τοῖς ἀνθρώποις.

controles.web: But when the multitudes saw it, they marveled and glorified God, who had given such authority to men.
controles.kjv: But when the multitudes saw it, they marvelled, and glorified God, which had given such power unto men.
controles.livre: Quando as multidões viram isto ,temeram, e glorificaram a Deus, que tinha dado tal autoridade aos homens.

versos.grego: Καὶ παράγων ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἐκεῖθεν εἶδεν ἄνθρωπον καθήμενον ἐπὶ τὸ τελώνιον, Μαθθαῖον λεγόμενον, καὶ λέγει αὐτῷ Ἀκολούθει μοι. καὶ ἀναστὰς ἠκολούθησεν αὐτῷ.

controles.web: As Jesus passed by from there, he saw a man called Matthew sitting at the tax collection office. He said to him, “Follow me.” He got up and followed him.
controles.kjv: And as Jesus passed forth from thence, he saw a man, named Matthew, sitting at the receipt of custom: and he saith unto him, Follow me. And he arose, and followed him.
controles.livre: E Jesus, ao passar dali, viu um homem sentado na coletoria de impostos, chamado Mateus; e disse-lhe: Segue-me. Então este se levantou e o seguiu.

versos.grego: Καὶ ἐγένετο αὐτοῦ ἀνακειμένου ἐν τῇ οἰκίᾳ, καὶ ἰδοὺ πολλοὶ τελῶναι καὶ ἁμαρτωλοὶ ἐλθόντες συνανέκειντο τῷ Ἰησοῦ καὶ τοῖς μαθηταῖς αὐτοῦ.

controles.web: As he sat in the house, behold, many tax collectors and sinners came and sat down with Jesus and his disciples.
controles.kjv: And it came to pass, as Jesus sat at meat in the house, behold, many publicans and sinners came and sat down with him and his disciples.
controles.livre: E aconteceu que, enquanto Jesus estava reclinado à mesa na casa de Mateus , eis que muitos cobradores de impostos e pecadores vieram e se reclinaram à mesa juntamente com Jesus e seus discípulos.

versos.grego: καὶ ἰδόντες οἱ Φαρισαῖοι ἔλεγον τοῖς μαθηταῖς αὐτοῦ Διὰ τί μετὰ τῶν τελωνῶν καὶ ἁμαρτωλῶν ἐσθίει ὁ διδάσκαλος ὑμῶν;

controles.web: When the Pharisees saw it, they said to his disciples, “Why does your teacher eat with tax collectors and sinners?”
controles.kjv: And when the Pharisees saw it, they said unto his disciples, Why eateth your Master with publicans and sinners?
controles.livre: E quando os fariseus viram isto , perguntaram aos seus discípulos: Por que o vosso Mestre come com cobradores de impostos e pecadores?

versos.grego: ὁ δὲ ἀκούσας εἶπεν Οὐ χρείαν ἔχουσιν οἱ ἰσχύοντες ἰατροῦ ἀλλ’ οἱ κακῶς ἔχοντες.

controles.web: When Jesus heard it, he said to them, “Those who are healthy have no need for a physician, but those who are sick do.
controles.kjv: But when Jesus heard that, he said unto them, They that be whole need not a physician, but they that are sick.
controles.livre: Porém Jesus ouviu, e respondeu: Os que têm saúde não precisam de médico, mas sim os que estão doentes.

versos.grego: πορευθέντες δὲ μάθετε τί ἐστιν Ἔλεος θέλω καὶ οὐ θυσίαν· οὐ γὰρ ἦλθον καλέσαι δικαίους ἀλλὰ ἁμαρτωλούς.

controles.web: But you go and learn what this means: ‘I desire mercy, and not sacrifice,’for I came not to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.”
controles.kjv: But go ye and learn what that meaneth, I will have mercy, and not sacrifice: for I am not come to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.
controles.livre: Mas ide aprender o que significa: “Quero misericórdia, e não sacrifício”.  Porque eu não vim chamar os justos, mas sim os pecadores.

versos.grego: Τότε προσέρχονται αὐτῷ οἱ μαθηταὶ Ἰωάνου λέγοντες Διὰ τί ἡμεῖς καὶ οἱ Φαρισαῖοι νηστεύομεν, οἱ δὲ μαθηταί σου οὐ νηστεύουσιν;

controles.web: Then John’s disciples came to him, saying, “Why do we and the Pharisees fast often, but your disciples don’t fast?”
controles.kjv: Then came to him the disciples of John, saying, Why do we and the Pharisees fast oft, but thy disciples fast not?
controles.livre: Então os discípulos de João vieram a ele, e perguntaram: Por que nós e os fariseus jejuamos, mas os teus discípulos não jejuam?

versos.grego: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς Μὴ δύνανται οἱ υἱοὶ τοῦ νυμφῶνος πενθεῖν ἐφ’ ὅσον μετ’ αὐτῶν ἐστιν ὁ νυμφίος; ἐλεύσονται δὲ ἡμέραι ὅταν ἀπαρθῇ ἀπ’ αὐτῶν ὁ νυμφίος, καὶ τότε νηστεύσουσιν.

controles.web: Jesus said to them, “Can the friends of the bridegroom mourn, as long as the bridegroom is with them? But the days will come when the bridegroom will be taken away from them, and then they will fast.
controles.kjv: And Jesus said unto them, Can the children of the bridechamber mourn, as long as the bridegroom is with them? but the days will come, when the bridegroom shall be taken from them, and then shall they fast.
controles.livre: E Jesus lhes respondeu: Podem, por acaso, os convidados do casamento  andar tristes enquanto o noivo está com eles? Mas dias virão, quando o noivo lhes for tirado, e então jejuarão.

versos.grego: οὐδεὶς δὲ ἐπιβάλλει ἐπίβλημα ῥάκους ἀγνάφου ἐπὶ ἱματίῳ παλαιῷ· αἴρει γὰρ τὸ πλήρωμα αὐτοῦ ἀπὸ τοῦ ἱματίου, καὶ χεῖρον σχίσμα γίνεται.

controles.web: No one puts a piece of unshrunk cloth on an old garment; for the patch would tear away from the garment, and a worse hole is made.
controles.kjv: No man putteth a piece of new cloth unto an old garment, for that which is put in to fill it up taketh from the garment, and the rent is made worse.
controles.livre: E ninguém põe remendo de pano novo em roupa velha; porque tal remendo rasga a roupa, e o rompimento se torna pior.

versos.grego: οὐδὲ βάλλουσιν οἶνον νέον εἰς ἀσκοὺς παλαιούς· εἰ δὲ μήγε, ῥήγνυνται οἱ ἀσκοί, καὶ ὁ οἶνος ἐκχεῖται καὶ οἱ ἀσκοὶ ἀπόλλυνται· ἀλλὰ βάλλουσιν οἶνον νέον εἰς ἀσκοὺς καινούς, καὶ ἀμφότεροι συντηροῦνται.

controles.web: Neither do people put new wine into old wine skins, or else the skins would burst, and the wine be spilled, and the skins ruined. No, they put new wine into fresh wine skins, and both are preserved.”
controles.kjv: Neither do men put new wine into old bottles: else the bottles break, and the wine runneth out, and the bottles perish: but they put new wine into new bottles, and both are preserved.
controles.livre: Nem põem vinho novo em odres  velhos; pois senão os odres se rompem, o vinho se derrama, e os odres se perdem; mas põem o vinho novo em odres novos, e ambos juntamente se conservam.

versos.grego: Ταῦτα αὐτοῦ λαλοῦντος αὐτοῖς ἰδοὺ ἄρχων εἷς προσελθὼν προσεκύνει αὐτῷ λέγων ὅτι Ἡ θυγάτηρ μου ἄρτι ἐτελεύτησεν· ἀλλὰ ἐλθὼν ἐπίθες τὴν χεῖρά σου ἐπ’ αὐτήν, καὶ ζήσεται.

controles.web: While he told these things to them, behold, a ruler came and worshiped him, saying, “My daughter has just died, but come and lay your hand on her, and she will live.”
controles.kjv: While he spake these things unto them, behold, there came a certain ruler, and worshipped him, saying, My daughter is even now dead: but come and lay thy hand upon her, and she shall live.
controles.livre: Enquanto ele lhes dizia estas coisas, eis que um chefe de sinagoga veio prostrar-se diante dele, e disse: Minha filha faleceu ainda agora; mas vem, e põe tua mão sobre ela, e ela viverá.

versos.grego: καὶ ἐγερθεὶς ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἠκολούθει αὐτῷ καὶ οἱ μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ.

controles.web: Jesus got up and followed him, as did his disciples.
controles.kjv: And Jesus arose, and followed him, and so did his disciples.
controles.livre: Então Jesus se levantou e o seguiu com seus discípulos.

versos.grego: Καὶ ἰδοὺ γυνὴ αἱμορροοῦσα δώδεκα ἔτη προσελθοῦσα ὄπισθεν ἥψατο τοῦ κρασπέδου τοῦ ἱματίου αὐτοῦ·

controles.web: Behold, a woman who had an issue of blood for twelve years came behind him, and touched the fringe of his garment;
controles.kjv: And, behold, a woman, which was diseased with an issue of blood twelve years, came behind him, and touched the hem of his garment:
controles.livre: (Eis, porém, que uma mulher enferma de um fluxo de sangue havia doze anos veio por detrás dele , e tocou a borda de sua roupa;

versos.grego: ἔλεγεν γὰρ ἐν ἑαυτῇ Ἐὰν μόνον ἅψωμαι τοῦ ἱματίου αὐτοῦ σωθήσομαι.

controles.web: for she said within herself, “If I just touch his garment, I will be made well.”
controles.kjv: For she said within herself, If I may but touch his garment, I shall be whole.
controles.livre: Porque dizia consigo mesma: Se eu tão-somente tocar a roupa dele, serei curada.

versos.grego: ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς στραφεὶς καὶ ἰδὼν αὐτὴν εἶπεν Θάρσει, θύγατερ· ἡ πίστις σου σέσωκέν σε. καὶ ἐσώθη ἡ γυνὴ ἀπὸ τῆς ὥρας ἐκείνης.

controles.web: But Jesus, turning around and seeing her, said, “Daughter, cheer up! Your faith has made you well.” And the woman was made well from that hour.
controles.kjv: But Jesus turned him about, and when he saw her, he said, Daughter, be of good comfort; thy faith hath made thee whole. And the woman was made whole from that hour.
controles.livre: Jesus se virou e a viu. Então disse: Tem bom ânimo, filha, a tua fé te sarou. E desde aquela hora a mulher ficou com saúde.)

versos.grego: καὶ ἐλθὼν ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἰς τὴν οἰκίαν τοῦ ἄρχοντος καὶ ἰδὼν τοὺς αὐλητὰς καὶ τὸν ὄχλον θορυβούμενον

controles.web: When Jesus came into the ruler’s house, and saw the flute players, and the crowd in noisy disorder,
controles.kjv: And when Jesus came into the ruler’s house, and saw the minstrels and the people making a noise,
controles.livre: Quando Jesus chegou à casa daquele chefe, viu os tocadores de flauta e a multidão que fazia alvoroço,

versos.grego: ἔλεγεν· Ἀναχωρεῖτε· οὐ γὰρ ἀπέθανεν τὸ κοράσιον ἀλλὰ καθεύδει. καὶ κατεγέλων αὐτοῦ.

controles.web: he said to them, “Make room, because the girl isn’t dead, but sleeping.”   They were ridiculing him.
controles.kjv: He said unto them, Give place: for the maid is not dead, but sleepeth. And they laughed him to scorn.
controles.livre: E disse: Retirai-vos, porque a menina não está morta, mas sim dormindo. E riram dele.

versos.grego: ὅτε δὲ ἐξεβλήθη ὁ ὄχλος, εἰσελθὼν ἐκράτησεν τῆς χειρὸς αὐτῆς, καὶ ἠγέρθη τὸ κοράσιον.

controles.web: But when the crowd was put out, he entered in, took her by the hand, and the girl arose.
controles.kjv: But when the people were put forth, he went in, and took her by the hand, and the maid arose.
controles.livre: Mas quando a multidão foi expulsa, ele entrou, pegou a mão dela, e a menina se levantou.

versos.grego: καὶ ἐξῆλθεν ἡ φήμη αὕτη εἰς ὅλην τὴν γῆν ἐκείνην.

controles.web: The report of this went out into all that land.
controles.kjv: And the fame hereof went abroad into all that land.
controles.livre: E esta notícia se espalhou por toda aquela terra.

versos.grego: Καὶ παράγοντι ἐκεῖθεν τῷ Ἰησοῦ ἠκολούθησαν δύο τυφλοὶ κράζοντες καὶ λέγοντες Ἐλέησον ἡμᾶς, υἱὸς Δαυείδ.

controles.web: As Jesus passed by from there, two blind men followed him, calling out and saying, “Have mercy on us, son of David!”
controles.kjv: And when Jesus departed thence, two blind men followed him, crying, and saying, Thou Son of David, have mercy on us.
controles.livre: E saindo Jesus dali, dois cegos o seguiram, gritando: Tem compaixão de nós, Filho de Davi!

versos.grego: ἐλθόντι δὲ εἰς τὴν οἰκίαν προσῆλθον αὐτῷ οἱ τυφλοί, καὶ λέγει αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς Πιστεύετε ὅτι δύναμαι τοῦτο ποιῆσαι; λέγουσιν αὐτῷ Ναί, Κύριε.

controles.web: When he had come into the house, the blind men came to him. Jesus said to them, “Do you believe that I am able to do this?”   They told him, “Yes, Lord.”
controles.kjv: And when he was come into the house, the blind men came to him: and Jesus saith unto them, Believe ye that I am able to do this? They said unto him, Yea, Lord.
controles.livre: E quando ele entrou em casa, os cegos vieram a ele. Jesus lhes perguntou: Credes que posso fazer isto? Eles lhe responderam: Sim, Senhor.

versos.grego: τότε ἥψατο τῶν ὀφθαλμῶν αὐτῶν λέγων Κατὰ τὴν πίστιν ὑμῶν γενηθήτω ὑμῖν.

controles.web: Then he touched their eyes, saying, “According to your faith be it done to you.”
controles.kjv: Then touched he their eyes, saying, According to your faith be it unto you.
controles.livre: Então tocou os olhos deles, dizendo: Seja feito convosco conforme a vossa fé.

versos.grego: καὶ ἠνεῴχθησαν αὐτῶν οἱ ὀφθαλμοί. καὶ ἐνεβριμήθη αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς λέγων Ὁρᾶτε, μηδεὶς γινωσκέτω.

controles.web: Their eyes were opened. Jesus strictly commanded them, saying, “See that no one knows about this.”
controles.kjv: And their eyes were opened; and Jesus straitly charged them, saying, See that no man know it.
controles.livre: E os olhos deles se abriram. Então Jesus os advertiu severamente, dizendo: Tende o cuidado de que ninguém saiba disso.

versos.grego: οἱ δὲ ἐξελθόντες διεφήμισαν αὐτὸν ἐν ὅλῃ τῇ γῇ ἐκείνῃ.

controles.web: But they went out and spread abroad his fame in all that land.
controles.kjv: But they, when they were departed, spread abroad his fame in all that country.
controles.livre: Porém eles saíram e divulgaram a notícia acerca dele por toda aquela terra.

versos.grego: Αὐτῶν δὲ ἐξερχομένων, ἰδοὺ προσήνεγκαν αὐτῷ κωφὸν δαιμονιζόμενον.

controles.web: As they went out, behold, a mute man who was demon possessed was brought to him.
controles.kjv: As they went out, behold, they brought to him a dumb man possessed with a devil.
controles.livre: Enquanto eles saíam, eis que lhe trouxeram um mudo e endemoninhado.

versos.grego: καὶ ἐκβληθέντος τοῦ δαιμονίου ἐλάλησεν ὁ κωφός. καὶ ἐθαύμασαν οἱ ὄχλοι λέγοντες Οὐδέποτε ἐφάνη οὕτως ἐν τῷ Ἰσραήλ.

controles.web: When the demon was cast out, the mute man spoke. The multitudes marveled, saying, “Nothing like this has ever been seen in Israel!”
controles.kjv: And when the devil was cast out, the dumb spake: and the multitudes marvelled, saying, It was never so seen in Israel.
controles.livre: Quando o demônio foi expulso, o mudo passou a falar. Então as multidões ficaram maravilhadas, e disseram: Nunca se viu algo assim em Israel!

versos.grego: οἱ δὲ Φαρισαῖοι ἔλεγον Ἐν τῷ ἄρχοντι τῶν δαιμονίων ἐκβάλλει τὰ δαιμόνια.

controles.web: But the Pharisees said, “By the prince of the demons, he casts out demons.”
controles.kjv: But the Pharisees said, He casteth out devils through the prince of the devils.
controles.livre: Mas os fariseus diziam: É pelo chefe dos demônios que ele expulsa os demônios.

versos.grego: Καὶ περιῆγεν ὁ Ἰησοῦς τὰς πόλεις πάσας καὶ τὰς κώμας, διδάσκων ἐν ταῖς συναγωγαῖς αὐτῶν καὶ κηρύσσων τὸ εὐαγγέλιον τῆς βασιλείας καὶ θεραπεύων πᾶσαν νόσον καὶ πᾶσαν μαλακίαν.

controles.web: Jesus went about all the cities and the villages, teaching in their synagogues, and preaching the Good News of the Kingdom, and healing every disease and every sickness among the people.
controles.kjv: And Jesus went about all the cities and villages, teaching in their synagogues, and preaching the gospel of the kingdom, and healing every sickness and every disease among the people.
controles.livre: Jesus percorria todas as cidades e aldeias, ensinando em suas sinagogas, pregando o Evangelho do Reino, e curando toda enfermidade e toda doença.

versos.grego: Ἰδὼν δὲ τοὺς ὄχλους ἐσπλαγχνίσθη περὶ αὐτῶν, ὅτι ἦσαν ἐσκυλμένοι καὶ ἐρριμμένοι ὡσεὶ πρόβατα μὴ ἔχοντα ποιμένα.

controles.web: But when he saw the multitudes, he was moved with compassion for them, because they were harassed and scattered, like sheep without a shepherd.
controles.kjv: But when he saw the multitudes, he was moved with compassion on them, because they fainted, and were scattered abroad, as sheep having no shepherd.
controles.livre: Quando ele viu as multidões, teve compaixão delas, porque andavam afligidas e desamparadas, como ovelhas que não têm pastor.

versos.grego: τότε λέγει τοῖς μαθηταῖς αὐτοῦ Ὁ μὲν θερισμὸς πολύς, οἱ δὲ ἐργάται ὀλίγοι·

controles.web: Then he said to his disciples, “The harvest indeed is plentiful, but the laborers are few.
controles.kjv: Then saith he unto his disciples, The harvest truly is plenteous, but the labourers are few;
controles.livre: Então disse aos seus discípulos: Em verdade a colheita é grande, porém os trabalhadores são poucos.

versos.grego: δεήθητε οὖν τοῦ Κυρίου τοῦ θερισμοῦ ὅπως ἐκβάλῃ ἐργάτας εἰς τὸν θερισμὸν αὐτοῦ.

controles.web: Pray therefore that the Lord of the harvest will send out laborers into his harvest.”
controles.kjv: Pray ye therefore the Lord of the harvest, that he will send forth labourers into his harvest.
controles.livre: Portanto rogai ao Senhor da colheita que envie trabalhadores à sua colheita.
